title: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Aviram
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Esther Rabbah 5:4. Hyman reports that Midrash Shmuel 13:5 gives the statement as Rabbi Yehoshua, son of Rabbi Biri. Yalkut Esther there has son of Rabbi Beri, which Hyman says should read Biri; Seder HaDorot copied son of Rabbi Kangri.

notes.text: Seder HaDorot is the work said to have copied Kangri. The Aviram/Biri/Beri/Kangri variants are not reconciled into one preferred father.
